analysis.title: Dassault Systemes (DAST.PA): 3Q26 First take: Modestly better top-line; FY26 guidance raised to reflect recent acquisition
key_insights: 3Q26 total revenue was EUR 1,551.9mn, up 5.0% yoy ex-fx against GS 3.8% and Visible Alpha consensus 4.0%. Revenue was about 2% above both GS and consensus in euro terms.
The top-line beat came mainly from licenses. Licenses were EUR 219.3mn, up 14.0% yoy ex-fx against GS 4.0% and consensus 2.5%, roughly 12% above GS and 14% above consensus in euros.

Recurring revenue was EUR 1,174.2mn, up 3.0% yoy ex-fx against GS 3.6% and consensus 4.2%. It was in line in euros but slower than expected in growth terms. ARR was stable at EUR 4,500mn, up 6.0% yoy ex-fx.
Life Sciences grew 1.0% yoy ex-fx against GS -1.6% and consensus -1.0%. GS notes this is the first positive-growth quarter in the segment since 4Q23.
Industrial Innovation grew 5.0% yoy ex-fx and Mainstream Innovation grew 8.0% yoy ex-fx, both described as stable in the quarter and both slightly above GS and consensus.

Operating income ex-exceptionals was EUR 490.2mn with a 31.6% margin against GS and consensus of 31.0%. Pro forma EPS was EUR 0.32 against GS and consensus of 0.31. FCF was EUR 275.1mn against consensus of EUR 142.9mn.
By geography, 3Q26 ex-fx growth was Americas -3%, Europe +9% and APAC +12%. 3DEXPERIENCE grew 25% and Cloud grew 14% yoy ex-fx.

FY26 guidance was raised across all key KPIs and now includes ArisGlobal. Software and total revenue growth are guided to about 4.5% ex-fx (from 3-5%), operating margin to 32.5-32.7% (from 32.2-32.6%) and diluted EPS to EUR 1.35-1.36 (from EUR 1.30-1.34).

4Q26 guidance is software and total revenue growth of 5-8% yoy ex-fx against GS 4.3-4.6% and consensus 5.6-5.9%. 4Q26 operating margin is guided to 37.2-37.8% and EPS to EUR 0.42-0.43. GS expects investors to focus on the guided acceleration into year-end on easier comps.

GS expects minimal upward revisions to consensus top-line and bottom-line forecasts, all else equal. GS stays Neutral with a EUR 21 price target against a EUR 24.69 share price, implying 14.9% downside.

Questions GS flags for the earnings call: end-market state and large-deal pipeline given geopolitical uncertainty, added ARR disclosure, growth in Industrial Innovation and Mainstream Innovation (particularly Centric), Medidata's structural competitiveness, 4Q26 opex phasing, and FCF conversion, M&A and use of cash.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps Neutral and a EUR 21 target (c.15x 3Q27-2Q28E PF EPS) after a modest 3Q26 beat and a guidance raise that includes ArisGlobal. The target sits 14.9% below the EUR 24.69 close.

Dassault 3Q26 reported licenses EUR 219.3mn, +14.0% yoy ex-fx, vs GSe EUR 196.6mn (+4.0%) and consensus EUR 191.9mn (+2.5%).
Dassault 3Q26 reported operating income ex-exceptionals EUR 490.2mn, margin 31.6%, vs GSe/consensus margin 31.0%. Reported pro forma EPS EUR 0.32 vs GSe/consensus EUR 0.31.
Dassault 3Q26 reported FCF EUR 275.1mn vs consensus EUR 142.9mn. ARR EUR 4,500mn, +6.0% yoy ex-fx.

Dassault FY26 company guidance (raised 10/28, includes ArisGlobal): software and total revenue growth 4-5% ex-fx (from 3-5%), operating margin 32.5-32.7% (from 32.2-32.6%), diluted EPS EUR 1.35-1.36 (from EUR 1.30-1.34). GSe EPS EUR 1.35 and Visible Alpha consensus EUR 1.34 are estimates.

Dassault 4Q26 company guidance: software and total revenue growth 5-8% yoy ex-fx, operating margin 37.2-37.8%, diluted EPS EUR 0.42-0.43. GSe is 4.3-4.6% growth and EPS EUR 0.43, and Visible Alpha consensus is 5.6-5.9% growth and EPS EUR 0.42 (estimates).
